act1/class_gate.title: The mirror pool
act1/class_gate.body: Three **oaths** echo in the round chamber. A fourth hunting whisper, without a banner. At the center, still **black water** — and your reflection takes a moment to catch up, as if choosing between **sword**, **bow**, and **holy symbol**.

choices.text: [#] Forge the path as Knight
[*] Unravel secrets as Mage
[+] Open the way as Cleric
choices.preview: Faith and purification against the undead.

choices.text: [-] Track prey as Archer
Stare into the black water: what does it reflect?
choices.preview: Luck check; success reveals the hand mirror.

choices.text: Listen: is there another sound besides dripping?
choices.preview: Mind check; success reveals the hand mirror.

choices.text: A hand mirror on the wall — hold it and see yourself without the water
Press on to the dungeon mouth
choices.preview: The oath is done; the air outside still listens.

act1/class_gate_listen.title: Listening
act1/class_gate_listen.body: Beyond the drip: a distant metallic scrape, like a chain pulled in the dark. Then **silence** — the kind that weighs.

act1/class_gate_water.title: Reflection
act1/class_gate_water.body: For an instant the reflection is not your face: bone and ripple. The water goes too still.
act1/class_gate_water.luckCheckLabel: Look into the black water without losing yourself in the reflection

act1/crawl_entrada.title: First step
act1/crawl_entrada.body: Cold stone under your palm. The damp stuck centuries ago and never fully dried.

choices.text: Accept the call and press on
choices.preview: Class choice and a firm first step.

choices.text: Press on to the dungeon mouth
choices.preview: Oath sworn; the air outside still listens.

choices.text: A shard of mirror gleams in the mortar — see your own face
choices.preview: Mirror route; diary mark before class.

choices.text: Touch the wall: is it cold or damp?
choices.preview: Tactile detail; light stress and a mark.

act1/crawl_touch.title: The wall
act1/crawl_touch.body: **Damp**, like sick skin. Under the salt crust, softer veins — almost fossilized flesh.

choices.text: Continue the descent
Press on to the dungeon mouth
choices.preview: Oath sworn; the air outside still listens.

choices.text: Step back a moment

onEnterDiaryTexts: The wall reminded me of flesh — and my hand trembled.

act1/dungeon_door.title: Doorframe
act1/dungeon_door.body: Faded runes were scored again by recent hands. Among them, a crude **bell** — the Third Bell, they say. The wood is damp inside.

choices.text: Enter the catacombs
Lean toward the bronze gleam on the frame — see yourself
choices.preview: Mirror on the frame; combat possible.

choices.text: Return to the last corridor (story)
choices.preview: Brazier, bell, and the stone mouth.

act1/dungeon_mouth.title: Dungeon mouth
act1/dungeon_mouth.body: The **stone mouth** creaks. Air weighs on your lungs — damp and cold. Inside, **silence** arrives first: you only hear your own breath.

choices.text: [!] Cracked brazier — tear off the seal (risk/reward)
choices.preview: May yield rare resources, but drains conviction.

choices.text: [!] Blind bell — promise blood to the echo (risk/reward)
choices.preview: Immediate power gain, with visible cost.

choices.text: Enter the catacombs
Inspect the doorframe
A twin echo pulses in you — faith and shadow recognize each other
diaryTexts: At the dungeon mouth, faith and corruption coexist without splitting you — the twin echo opened a thread of calm.

act1/encounters/risk_bell.title: Blind bell
act1/encounters/risk_bell.body: A **bell without a clapper** swings alone on fine chains. The metal mouth has the sheen of fresh flesh.

choices.text: Bleed on the bell's edge to bargain passage
diaryTexts: The bell drank blood and returned power. The Cult will know.

choices.text: Cover the bell and move on in silence
diaryTexts: I covered the bell and refused the pact. The Vigil would call this discipline.

act1/encounters/risk_brazier.title: Cracked brazier
act1/encounters/risk_brazier.body: The **brazier** is cracked top to bottom. A wax seal holds a sack of provisions at the bottom.

choices.text: Tear off the seal and swallow the taste of rust
diaryTexts: I ripped a hot seal and took rations; faith came out thinner.

choices.text: Leave the seal and withdraw
diaryTexts: I did not touch the cracked brazier. Hunger waits for another day.

act1/mirror_descent.title: Shard on the step
act1/mirror_descent.body: In the mortar, a **mirror shard** returns *{{playerName}}* weary, mouth tighter than you remembered. Old fear: coming back the same if the shadow wins above before you do.

choices.text: Lower your eyes and continue the descent
Press on to the dungeon mouth
choices.preview: Oath sworn; the air outside still listens.

choices.text: Turn from the gleam and return to the previous step

onEnterDiaryTexts: I saw myself in a mirror shard: a stranger with my name.

act1/mirror_door.title: Bronze on the frame
act1/mirror_door.body: In the wood, **polished bronze** returns your face greenish. The armor looks borrowed.

choices.text: Look away and return to the doorframe
choices.preview: No combat; back to the runes.

choices.text: [%] Stare into the mirror until the reflection yields
choices.preview: Dialogue combat; victory marks the mirror.

act1/mirror_door_resolved.title: Bronze on the frame
act1/mirror_door_resolved.body: The **bronze** goes dull again. You still feel the lagging gaze, as if it were keeping your name for later.

choices.text: Look away and return to the doorframe

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the bronze on the frame, the reflection yielded — but it still recognizes me from the side.

act1/mirror_entrance.title: Glass against stone
act1/mirror_entrance.body: In the niche, a broken **oval mirror**: half your face, half the tunnel. The glass returns *{{playerName}}* choosing the silent city — before silence chooses for you.

choices.text: Leave and return to the inscriptions

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the niche, half my face and half the tunnel — the same cut.

act1/mirror_round.title: Mirror on the wheel
act1/mirror_round.body: A **hand mirror** on a rusted chain. Ridiculous here — but the glass trembles, and *{{playerName}}* faces *{{playerName}}* without black water lying.

choices.text: Release your breath and return to the chamber center
Release your breath and press on
choices.preview: Oath sworn; the air outside still listens.

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the hand mirror, only me — without the water lying.

act1/pick_cleric.title: Cleric's oath
act1/pick_cleric.body: The emblem burns cold in your palm. Old words push the veil aside.

choices.text: Advance to the dungeon mouth

act1/pick_knight.title: Knight's oath
act1/pick_knight.body: The metal obeys. The **Order of the Vigil** approves in the folds of the armor.

choices.text: Advance to the dungeon mouth

act1/pick_mage.title: Mage's oath
act1/pick_mage.body: Symbols ignite on your retina. The **Grey Circle** does not forgive hesitation.

choices.text: Advance to the dungeon mouth

act1/pick_archer.title: Archer's oath
act1/pick_archer.body: The string sings once — dry, honest. No one calls you brother. Only the **target** you have not yet seen waits for you to count steps before glory.

choices.text: Advance to the dungeon mouth

act1/surface_whisper.title: Whisper in the throat
act1/surface_whisper.body: You press your ear to the **stone**. From above come cut voices: bread prices, doors shut early, fear of looking where shadow feeds.
act1/surface_whisper.luckCheckLabel: Listen to what rises from the city before the stone swallows it

act1/surface_whisper_fail.title: Corroding noise
act1/surface_whisper_fail.body: The stone returns a laugh that is not yours — damp, sweet, wrong. The echo stays on your tongue like old iron.

choices.text: Pull your ear away and return to the inscriptions

onEnterDiaryTexts: What rose was not conversation — it was broken laughter that entered my mouth uninvited.

act1/surface_whisper_ok.title: Information that pays
act1/surface_whisper_ok.body: You catch **two** words worth gold: who closes the warehouse at the fourth stroke, and where the vicar keeps the debt ledger. Not a miracle — a **map**.

choices.text: Keep the rumor and return to the inscriptions

onEnterDiaryTexts: I heard who pays the vicar not to speak the dead man's name — and noted market day.

act1/title.title: Opening
act1/title.body: The **green pulse** climbs the city's throat. Below, the **dungeon** opens a mute mouth: damp stone, old iron, **silence** that pushes you in. Above they pretend routine.

choices.text: Descend the steps toward the text carved in stone
choices.preview: The first firm step — or hesitate and look first.

choices.text: Examine the symbols at the entrance (before descending)
Breathe deep and adjust your equipment

act1/title_breath.title: A moment
act1/title_breath.body: Surface air tastes **sweet** for a second. Then the green pulse reminds you: sweetness is a lie.

choices.text: Go back over what happened in the village — why you descend
Ready. Descend.
Return to the entrance
choices.preview: No cost; hesitation is still an option.

act1/title_examine.title: Inscriptions
act1/title_examine.body: Someone chiseled **three lines** before rust ate the stone: > *"Here there is no forgiveness — only echo."

choices.text: Notice a broken mirror in a niche — face the reflection
choices.preview: Just looking; the abyss returns your face.

choices.text: [%] Listen to voices descending from the city (luck)
choices.preview: Gold or corruption — rumor from the surface.

choices.text: Return to the entrance
choices.preview: No risk; back to the threshold.
